subject: Unidentified GCP marketplace line items — need lineage + VAT impact
messages:
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa@brightstack.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: BrightStack Finance <billing@brightstack.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strange GCP marketplace charges on Oct invoice — need help

Hi Jonas,

We pulled our October marketplace invoice and see three line items we don't recognize (marked as marketplace refunds/charges) that total $12,438 before VAT. Our finance team placed a temporary hold on payment until we understand lineage — they want to know if these are reseller adjustments, billing credits, or duplicate meter stamps from your usage ingestion.

Attached: gcp_oct_invoice.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB), brightstack_usage_extract.csv (csv, 45KB). The CSV matches the invoice lines to usage IDs — two of the IDs (usage_ee-98765 and usage_ee-98766) look like duplicates but we can't prove it from our portal.

Questions:
- Can Redwood confirm whether those two usage IDs correspond to the same metering event (duplication) or are legitimate distinct charges?
- What's the expected VAT treatment if these are Redwood-originated credits vs GCP marketplace-level adjustments?

We're under a payment cutoff next week and need direction so we can clear our ledger. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Alyssa Kim
Head of Finance, BrightStack
Alyssa Kim | +1 415-555-0191

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the quick heads-up and for sending the CSV. I'm copying Marissa (sales lead) and Mateo (marketplace ops) so we can triage and get you a clear lineage.

Immediate plan:
1) Mateo will pull raw ingestion logs and compare GCP metering stamps to the invoice stamps you sent.
2) If we see duplicated ingestion, we will propose a credit memo and a VAT reconciliation note for your finance team.
3) If the charge originates at GCP (platform-level adjustment), we'll open a ticket with GCP Marketplace Support and loop you in.

Please confirm if BrightStack is comfortable with Redwood opening a support ticket with GCP on your behalf (we typically include a limited info release authorization). Also, can you confirm whether BrightStack prefers a credit memo or an immediate offset against next month's invoice if we confirm duplication?

Attaching a short request template that helps us gather ID-level evidence: request_template.xlsx (stub). Can you also share any internal billing screenshots that show the two usage IDs?

I'll follow up once Mateo shares findings — target ETA: 72 hours.

Best,

Hi Alyssa — we completed the ingestion comparison and reconciliation. Summary below and proposed next steps so your AR team can clear the hold: 

Findings (short):
- Root cause: a legacy ingestion agent re-sent a small batch on 2026-09-29 which produced duplicate metering stamps for two usage IDs. The raw stamps match the two entries you highlighted (usage_ee-98765 and usage_ee-98766).
- Impact: two duplicated metering lines that map to $12,438 pre-VAT. These were Redwood-originated duplicates, not GCP platform credits.
- VAT implication: because these are corrections arising from Redwood's ingestion layer (not a marketplace platform tax adjustment), the credit memo will carry the same tax treatment as the original invoices; BrightStack will receive a VAT-deductible credit memo and supporting reconciliation so you can claim the adjustment in your VAT reports.

Proposed remedial actions and timeline:
1) We will issue a draft credit memo for $12,438 and email it to BrightStack finance by EOD tomorrow (attachment: credit_memo_draft.pdf).
2) We will provide a reconciliation bundle that includes raw ingestion logs, the invoice mapping table, and a VAT treatment note (attachment: reconciliation_sheet.csv).
3) Redwood engineering has patched the ingestion agent to dedupe identical stamps; we'll provide evidence of the patch and a short post-mortem by next week.
4) If BrightStack prefers an immediate offset instead, confirm and we can apply to the Nov invoice; otherwise we'll proceed with credit memo issuance.

Next steps for AR: please confirm whether you prefer a credit memo or an invoice offset. Also share the contact for your VAT reclaim department so we can tailor the reconciliation note.

Thanks for your patience — apologies for the disruption. We'll expedite the credit memo so collections can proceed.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
